intended_object: This is the restriction monoid homomorphism. For a monoid G with C^n multiplication (for example a Lie group) and open sets U ⊆ V of a manifold N, it sends a C^n map V → G to its restriction U → G. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The map sends f to f ∘ Set.inclusion h, which is the restriction from V to U. It is C^n because f is composed with the smooth inclusion (contMDiff_inclusion h). The monoid operations on C^n⟮I, V; I', G⟯ are pointwise, so preserving 1 and multiplication holds by rfl. The hypotheses are a monoid G with ContMDiffMul, which is weaker than the Lie group of the docstring. This is exactly the setting in which these function spaces carry a monoid structure, so the generality is natural. The additive version is produced by to_additive. The definition matches the intended object.
